hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$f" ;; *.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run --quiet ruff format --force-exclude "$f" ;; esac >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
